title: Knowledge-graph chunk extraction
description: Entities and directed relations extracted from one text chunk. Relations may only reference entities present in the entities list.

name.description: Canonical display name as the text names it — full name, no pronouns, no leading articles.

description.description: One factual sentence about the entity drawn from this chunk only; empty when the chunk says nothing about it.

source.description: Name of an entity from the entities list, spelled exactly as listed.

target.description: Name of an entity from the entities list, spelled exactly as listed.

relation.description: Lowercase verb phrase of at most a few words, e.g. "operates", "depends on".

description.description: One factual sentence of supporting context from the chunk, or empty.
